checklist_item: Identify the report as a systematic review.
location: Abstract (review design: "This paper presents a systematic review following PRISMA 2020 ..."); Keywords ("PRISMA", "Systematic Review")

checklist_item: See the PRISMA 2020 for Abstracts checklist.
location: Abstract (PRISMA 2020 statement, information sources, number of included studies, main findings)
note: PRISMA 2020 for Abstracts items not in the abstract: search dates, eligibility criteria, appraisal method, limitations of evidence, funding, registration.

checklist_item: Describe the rationale for the review in the context of existing knowledge.
location: Section I

checklist_item: Provide an explicit statement of the objective(s) or question(s) the review addresses.
location: Section I (aim and contributions); Section II-A (research questions RQ1–RQ3)

checklist_item: Specify the inclusion and exclusion criteria for the review and how studies were grouped for the syntheses.
location: Section II-B; Table 1 (codes I1–I4, E1–E5, tiers A1/A2); grouping for synthesis: Section II-G

checklist_item: Specify all databases, registers, websites, organisations, reference lists and other sources searched or consulted to identify studies. Specify the date when each source was last searched or consulted.
location: Section II-C; Table 2 (sources, interfaces and search dates)

checklist_item: Present the full search strategies for all databases, registers and websites, including any filters and limits used.
location: Appendix A: Table 13; concept blocks in Section II-C
note: Executed strings, filters and counts are also in the reproducibility package (queries/).

checklist_item: Specify the methods used to decide whether a study met the inclusion criteria of the review, including how many reviewers screened each record and each report retrieved, whether they worked independently, and if applicable, details of automation tools used in the process.
location: Section II-D
note: The first author conducted the initial screening and full-text eligibility assessment; the other two authors reviewed the 18 provisionally eligible studies, and nine borderline cases concerning HPC-related eligibility were additionally reassessed by a co-author with HPC expertise; the final study selection was agreed upon following discussion among the authors (Appendix B); deduplication was scripted (package scripts/04_merge_dedup.py).

checklist_item: Specify the methods used to collect data from reports, including how many reviewers collected data from each report, whether they worked independently, any processes for obtaining or confirming data from study investigators, and if applicable, details of automation tools used in the process.
location: Section II-F
note: Data were extracted from the full texts of the included studies by the first author. Study investigators were not contacted.

checklist_item: List and define all outcomes for which data were sought. Specify whether all results that were compatible with each outcome domain in each study were sought (e.g. for all measures, time points, analyses), and if not, the methods used to decide which results to collect.
location: Section II-F (runtime, speedup, efficiency, throughput and scaling results, with hardware, problem size, worker count and baseline; all such results sought)

checklist_item: List and define all other variables for which data were sought (e.g. participant and intervention characteristics, funding sources). Describe any assumptions made about any missing or unclear information.
location: Section II-F (data items; derived and missing values)

checklist_item: Specify the methods used to assess risk of bias in the included studies, including details of the tool(s) used, how many reviewers assessed each study and whether they worked independently, and if applicable, details of automation tools used in the process.
location: Section II-F; Table 3 (QA1–QA6 reporting-quality checklist and evidence classes E-S, E-C, E-T, E-Q)
note: The QA checklist assesses reporting completeness of the HPC evidence; it is stated in the manuscript not to be a risk-of-bias instrument. The number of assessors is not stated separately from data extraction.

checklist_item: Specify for each outcome the effect measure(s) (e.g. risk ratio, mean difference) used in the synthesis or presentation of results.
location: Section II-F (performance metrics as reported: speedup, efficiency, runtime, throughput); Section II-G
note: No pooled effect measure; results are presented in the units reported by each study.

checklist_item: Describe the processes used to decide which studies were eligible for each synthesis (e.g. tabulating the study intervention characteristics and comparing against the planned groups for each synthesis (item #5)).
location: Section II-G; Section II-B (tiers A1 and A2)

checklist_item: Describe any methods required to prepare the data for presentation or synthesis, such as handling of missing summary statistics, or data conversions.
location: Section II-F (derived values marked, missing items marked as not reported; units as reported)

checklist_item: Describe any methods used to tabulate or visually display results of individual studies and syntheses.
location: Section II-G; Table 7, Table 8, Table 9, Table 6

checklist_item: Describe any methods used to synthesize results and provide a rationale for the choice(s). If meta-analysis was performed, describe the model(s), method(s) to identify the presence and extent of statistical heterogeneity, and software package(s) used.
location: Section II-G (descriptive synthesis; reasons for not pooling)

checklist_item: Describe any methods used to explore possible causes of heterogeneity among study results (e.g. subgroup analysis, meta-regression).
location: Not applicable — no meta-analysis or statistical synthesis; sources of heterogeneity (hardware, problem size, baseline, metric) are described in Section II-G

checklist_item: Describe any sensitivity analyses conducted to assess robustness of the synthesized results.
location: Not applicable — no statistical synthesis; no sensitivity analysis was conducted

checklist_item: Describe any methods used to assess risk of bias due to missing results in a synthesis (arising from reporting biases).
location: Not applicable — no statistical synthesis was performed; risk of missing studies is addressed in Section VI

checklist_item: Describe any methods used to assess certainty (or confidence) in the body of evidence for an outcome.
location: Section II-F (evidence classes grade the strength of each performance claim)
note: No formal certainty framework (e.g., GRADE) was applied.

checklist_item: Describe the results of the search and selection process, from the number of records identified in the search to the number of studies included in the review, ideally using a flow diagram.
location: Section II-E; Fig. 2; Table 2

checklist_item: Cite studies that might appear to meet the inclusion criteria, but which were excluded, and explain why they were excluded.
location: Section II-E and Table 14 (reports that might appear to meet the criteria, with the reasons for exclusion); Section V-B (related studies, not counted); Section V-D and Table 12 (adjacent path-planning studies excluded under I2, discussed only for their parallel schemes, not counted); Table 14 also lists one report that met all criteria and was not retained by a later author decision (Section II-E)

checklist_item: Cite each included study and present its characteristics.
location: Section V-B; Table 7; Table 8; Table 9; Table 6

checklist_item: Present assessments of risk of bias for each included study.
location: Table 8 and Table 9 (per-study QA scores and evidence class)
note: Reporting-quality appraisal, not risk of bias (see item 11).

checklist_item: For all outcomes, present, for each study: (a) summary statistics for each group (where appropriate) and (b) an effect estimate and its precision (e.g. confidence/credible interval), ideally using structured tables or plots.
location: Table 8; Table 9; Section V-B
note: Reported runtimes, speedups and throughputs per study; no effect estimates with confidence intervals are available in the primary studies.

checklist_item: For each synthesis, briefly summarise the characteristics and risk of bias among contributing studies.
location: Section V-B; Section V-C

checklist_item: Present results of all statistical syntheses conducted. If meta-analysis was done, present for each the summary estimate and its precision (e.g. confidence/credible interval) and measures of statistical heterogeneity. If comparing groups, describe the direction of the effect.
location: Not applicable — no statistical synthesis (descriptive synthesis, Section II-G)

checklist_item: Present results of all investigations of possible causes of heterogeneity among study results.
location: Not applicable — no statistical synthesis; no investigation of heterogeneity

checklist_item: Present results of all sensitivity analyses conducted to assess the robustness of the synthesized results.
location: Not applicable — no statistical synthesis; no sensitivity analysis

checklist_item: Present assessments of risk of bias due to missing results (arising from reporting biases) for each synthesis assessed.
location: Not applicable — no statistical synthesis (see item 14)

checklist_item: Present assessments of certainty (or confidence) in the body of evidence for each outcome assessed.
location: Table 8 and Table 9 (evidence class per study); Section V-B; Section VI

checklist_item: Provide a general interpretation of the results in the context of other evidence.
location: Section V-C; Section VI

checklist_item: Discuss any limitations of the evidence included in the review.
location: Section V-B (comparability of reported results, evidence classes); Section VI

checklist_item: Discuss any limitations of the review processes used.
location: Section VI

checklist_item: Discuss implications of the results for practice, policy, and future research.
location: Section V-C; Table 11; Section VI

checklist_item: Provide registration information for the review, including register name and registration number, or state that the review was not registered.
location: Section II (the review was not registered)

checklist_item: Indicate where the review protocol can be accessed, or state that a protocol was not prepared.
location: Section II (protocol released in the reproducibility package)

checklist_item: Describe and explain any amendments to information provided at registration or in the protocol.
location: Section II-C (protocol amendment of 2026-10-05: extended routing and maritime blocks, environment block removed from the query and applied at screening; reason and dates stated). Separately, after full-text assessment, one report that met all criteria was not retained by author decision after discussion (Section II-E, Table 14); the search and the eligibility criteria were not changed

checklist_item: Describe sources of financial or non-financial support for the review, and the role of the funders or sponsors in the review.
location: Funding statement (end matter: no specific grant)

checklist_item: Declare any competing interests of review authors.
location: Conflict of Interest statement (end matter)

topic: Availability of data, code and other materials
checklist_item: Report which of the following are publicly available and where they can be found: template data collection forms; data extracted from included studies; data used for all analyses; analytic code; any other materials used in the review.
location: Section II (GitHub repository: protocol, search strings, deduplication log, screening decisions, extraction sheet, scripts)
